attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin for non-interactive local SSH using a 3072-bit RSA key and strictly pinned server host keys. Unexpected host keys are rejected without prompting. Configuration persisted across node1’s verified reboot; RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, OpenSSH packages, SELinux, firewall, and system SSH configuration remained intact.
